title: Encounter in the Realm of Dreams
description: Following Paimon's whim, you return to Inazuma where you encounter an unknown youkai. Intrigued by this small creature, you are drawn into a moonlit encounter...

mainQuestExcel.title: Encounter in the Realm of Dreams
mainQuestExcel.description: Following Paimon's whim, you return to Inazuma where you encounter an unknown youkai. Intrigued by this small creature, you are drawn into a moonlit encounter...

dialogs.text: Ahh, remember when we chased that tanuki down this way? Good times!
Huh? What's that?
A tanuki?
Paimon doesn't think they look anything like that... Oh, maybe there's a new kind of youkai in town?
Umm.... Is it trying to get us to follow it?
A piglet?
What's that girl doing over there?
She doesn't look well... Let's go check on her.
What just happened? All we did was lock eyes with her for a split-second, and then...
Wait, where did all these people come from? And what are they here for?
Looks like they're waiting in line for some reason.
True... Oh, and there's that girl! She's still here. Hmm, maybe she knows what happened?
If I leave now, will I have enough time?
How many times do I have to explain?
There's no going back if I report him. But still...
Hmm... anxiety over a lack of creative inspiration... Well, inspiration tends to give anxious minds a wide berth, so I hope our treatment will help you relax.
...Thank you.

...Remorse for the misdeeds of the past, and despair over the sorry state of the present... I can help you face your troubles with a more positive mindset, but you'll need to work through things in your own time, too.
...Many thanks.
Next please! *cough*...
What's wrong with her?
Are you alright?
I'm fine. Next, please...
Um...
Mmm! Delicious!
Whoa, that was unexpected...
Huh? What do we have here... *burp*! Oh no, I'm so sorry...
Sorry for what? We have no idea what's going on here, let alone what you're sorry for. Would you mind bringing us up to speed?
It looks like you entered my dream by mistake. Let me wake you up, then I'll explain everything.
Dream? When did that—
Whoa...
#Hi! Feeling more awake now? Heh, I never expected {NICKNAME} to literally come to me in a dream.
How do you know who I am?
Oh, someone I know talks about you all the time. Plus... I'm pretty good at profiling people based on their reputation.
So who are you?
Right, of course. It's our first time meeting each other, so I should introduce myself properly.
My name is Yumemizuki Mizuki — or just "Mizuki" for short. I'm a yumekui-baku, which is a kind of youkai here in Inazuma.
Yumekui-baku?
*hum*
Hey, it's that little critter from before...
That's what we look like in our original form. I'm guessing that's the one that led you into my dream earlier?
Baku feast on the bad dreams of human beings — but we need to be in a dream of our own to digest them. The place where you met me earlier was where I go to digest bad dreams.
I must have swallowed one too many bad dreams, because they were causing me some digestive trouble... It's actually a good thing you showed up when you did.
Call it a happy accident, I guess. Thanks to your help, I'm now able to digest all these dreams properly.
Yeah, we thought you looked a little uncomfortable. That's why we came over. We didn't know what it was, we just thought maybe you could use some help.
And Paimon really hates bad dreams, so Paimon's even more happy to help knowing that you can eat them!
Thank you... but I still owe you an apology...
For what?
While you were inside my dream... I ate one of your dreams, but it wasn't a bad one. It was a nice one.
I've eaten so many bad dreams today that I just scarfed it down without noticing...
So yumekui-baku can eat good dreams too, huh... Still, is that really such a big deal?
Of course it is. Dreams are some of the most precious things a person can have, and I just went and gobbled it down...
It's the unwritten rule of my kind: Never eat someone else's good dreams without permission. I can't believe I was so careless.
Don't beat yourself up.
But... Don't you feel horribly depressed? Isn't your mind suddenly flooded with distressing memories?
Nope.
Remarkable... I've never heard of someone remaining so mentally stable after having a good dream of theirs devoured...
#Umm... It's probably because {NICKNAME} has too many good dreams to count!
Maybe, but I still owe you something for your trouble... Ah! Here, take this.
It's a VIP pass for the Aisa Bathhouse...
"Staffed by clinical psychologists and offering spa and fine dining services, we invite you to bring us your troubles and leave refreshed and renewed"...
That's where I work. You'll find the address on there, too.
This invitation letter entitles you to enjoy our highest-tier service, free of charge... Oh, and speaking of work — I'd better get back before I'm missed.
Hope to see you as customers soon!
So she's a yumekui-baku that eats bad dreams and a clinical psychologist, too?
It adds up.
Paimon's never considered therapy before. Then again, Paimon never really gets that stressed out. Except when she's trying to decide what to eat...

Speaking of eating — that bathhouse place does fine dining, and we have a VIP pass. That means we can eat as much as we want, right? This is the opportunity of a lifetime! We can't let it go to waste!
Yeah. Kinda cool...
I feel fine.
